Titles.eng: Dragon Ball Z: Broly – The Legendary Super Saiyan
Titles.jpn: ドラゴンボールZ 燃えつきろ!!熱戦・烈戦・超激戦

Summaries.eng: On his planet in the Otherworld, King Kai senses the destruction of the South Galaxy by an unknown Super Saiyan, telepathically contacting Goku upon realizing the that the Milky Way will be targeted next. At that moment, Goku and Chi-Chi (Dragon Ball) are sitting down having an interview at a private school which they hope Gohan (Dragon Ball) will attend, Goku abruptly uses teleportation to reach King Kai's planet and get the entire story.
Summaries.jpn: べジータを「新惑星ベジータ」の王に迎えたい、とパラガス・ブロリー親子がやってきた。一方、悟空は界王の依頼で、銀河を襲い破壊している伝説の超サイヤ人を探していた。そう、悟空の探していた相手こそ、ブロリーだったのだ！

Aliases: Dragon Ball Z Movie 08 - Broly, The Legendary Super Saiyan
